profile.headline: Software Engineer at Tellabs
profile.summary:
Accomplished Software Engineer experienced in architecture, design and development of next-generation embedded software products. Detailed oriented and dependable with excellent skills in troubleshooting, analyzing, and resolving critical problems. Proven track record in delivering high quality software on time. Experienced with all software development life cycle stages.

Expertise:
- Linux/Embedded Linux (Ubuntu, RHEL, MontaVista, NXP-SDK)
- YOCTO Project ("Dunfell"), Denx-ELDK
- U-Boot

- Object Oriented Design, UML, C++11, C
- Eclipse IDE
- Git, ClearCase
- GNU tools
- Shell-Scripting, Perl, Tcl, Expect

- NXP PowerPC Architecture (P2020, T1042)
- Broadcom StrataDNX: BCM88470 (Qumran), BCM88670 (Jericho), BCM88650 (Arad)
- PMC DIGI 120G
- Marvell HX4130

- Network Management - NETCONF, YANG, CLI, SNMP, CMIP, TL1
- MEF 10.3, Ethernet Private Line, Ethernet Virtual Private Line
- OTN (G.709, G.798, G.873.1)

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software design and development of a 300G Optical LAN/XGSPON OLT
Embedded Linux on Intel CPU and NXP PowerPC architectures
Custom Linux distros based on Yocto 3.1/4.0, C++11
Ethernet management using Broadcom StrataDNX chipsets.
positions.insights: Skills: Ethernet · Embedded Linux · Device Drivers · YANG · Yocto Project

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software architecture, design, and implementation of a next generation coherent 100G/100G+ channel card supporting 100G, 200G, 300G and 400G channels.
Embedded Linux, C++
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software · OTN · C++ · Embedded Linux · Eclipse

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
AT&T Domain 2.0
YANG model development for a disaggregated Optical Transport System consisting of 100G coherent transponders, ROADMs, and pluggable optics.
NETCONF, YANG (RFC 6020, RFC 6021)

FW9500 (Packet Optical Networking Platform)
Architecture and design of next generation 10G/100G Ethernet switching capabilities.
Hardware Abstraction Layer interface definition for Ethernet Traffic Management (MEF 10.3) using Google Protocol Buffers.
positions.insights: Skills: System Architecture · NETCONF · YANG · Embedded Systems

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architecture, design, and development of the protection and switching capabilities for an advanced Optical Transport Network (OTN) platform adhering to ITU OTN standards G.709, G.798, G.873.1, etc.
Embedded Linux on PowerPC QorIQ architecture, Denx-ELDK, U-Boot, POSIX multi-threading, C++, ENEA Linx IPC, SQLite, device driver integration

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
FW9500 (Packet Optical Networking Platform)
Design and development of new generation Optical Transport Network (OTN) switch fabric
OTN (G.709, G.798),  OTN SNCP (G.873.1)
OSE, C++

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and development of application software for various embedded software products. Test automation and software integration testing. Customer support during installation and in-service-upgrade of products. 

Key projects:

1870 TTS (Transport Tera Switch)
ODU connection and ODU subnetwork connection protection for multi-terabit OTN switch
OTN (G.709, G.798),  OTN SNCP (G.873.1)
C++, embedded Linux (RedHat, MontaVista)

1678 MCC (Metro Core Connect)
Ethernet over SDH/SONET, Ethernet Privat Line (EPL), Ethernet Virtual Privat Line (EVPL), VLAN tagging - 802.1Q, MEF10
C++, embedded Linux (RedHat, MontaVista)

1677 SL (Sonet Link Cross Connect)
SONET Cross Conect, software integration and test automation, customer support
C++, VxWorks, Perl

1696 MS (Metro Span DWDM)
Metro DWDM - OAM functionality, test automation framework
C, pSOS, HTML

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and development of Network Management software for optical Cross-Connects and meshed optical transport networks.

Key projects:

1680 OGX (Optical Gateway Cross-Connect)
Q3 MIB development (ASN.1, GDMO, CMIP)
C++, Unix (SUN Solaris)

1354 CMF (Circuit Management Facility)
end-to-end path management for large meshed transport networks
embedded SQL, Oracle PL/SQL, PRO C, Unix

educations.schoolName: Hochschule Esslingen - University of Applied Sciences
